Pedal Power Saturday Morning Ride

Middletown, CT · Main Street · Road

Pedal Power Saturday Morning Ride is a road group ride in Middletown, CT. It rolls every Saturday at 9:00 am from Pedal Power Middletown (rear parking lot). About 20–40 miles, b (30–40 mi) and C (20–30 mi) groups.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: b (30–40 mi) and C (20–30 mi) groups. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Pedal Power Saturday Morning Ride group ride

An un-led Saturday shop ride from the rear lot of Pedal Power in Middletown. B and C groups, no support vehicle. Pedal Power's Tuesday Middletown and Wednesday Essex rides wrap up mid-September; this one keeps going.
